selectionOutcomes.description: The notes action declares PaperlessNotePermissions, which controls authorization before the handler executes.
The handler resolves the target document, including its owner, and performs the document view check.
The POST branch checks change_document before creating a note.
This range creates the note and updates the document after authorization checks.
The owner-aware helper resolves authorization using owner absence, owner identity, or the object permission checker.
Binds the notes endpoint to PaperlessNotePermissions before handler execution.
Resolves the document with its owner and performs the document-view check used before POST handling.
Shows the POST-specific change_document authorization gate at handler entry.
Shows note creation, audit logging, and document modification after authorization checks.
Shows that owner-aware object checks allow an owner or an object permission, while an ownerless object follows the separate owner-none branch.
Shows the global model-permission requirements mapped to POST and the authentication gate.
Shows the object-permission behavior distinguishing an identified owner, a non-owner delegated to object permission checks, and an ownerless object.
